note: Files: studies/rlneurons/results/axis/math500-01/vectors.json + manifest.json (in git), studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/per_problem.json (in git); studies/rlneurons/data/shots1/rl.json only to check the draw used problem_indices [0,1,2]. Arm R is found in the manifest as the single cue arm whose 'what' says 'written by Math-RL' with a shots1 run folder (it is shots_rl, job abaybektursun-1114-183901-fd89); the script stops with not_computable if that is not unique. M = {precalculus, intermediate_algebra, algebra} from per_problem.json. Main number: pooled mean of g = R - mean(B0..B3) over the matched problems minus the same over the unmatched ones (problems weighted equally). alt_measured: each subject weighted equally (mean of per-subject mean g on each side). n = the smaller group (unmatched, about 223). The interval comes from bootstrapping over the kept problems, so the group sizes vary across resamples. shots_rl has nulls only at 0-2, and the B arms have none, so about 497 problems are kept. Vectors are v3 0/1 with cap hits already 0, as the recipe says; the script does not regrade.

Same files as k 1. Arm E = the manifest arm whose job_id is abaybektursun-1114-183855-e840 (shots_base, base-written examples of problems 0,1,2 per studies/rlneurons/data/shots1/base.json). Same pooled matched-minus-unmatched contrast, same alt_measured (subjects weighted equally), n = the smaller group. refuted_by is coded as |S_E| > 0.045 on the main number.

Files: vectors.json + manifest.json. Arm R chosen as in k 1 (shots_rl). Z = kept problems (0,1,2 and nulls dropped) with base_cue_s0..s3 all 0. Main number = count of Z with R == 1; |Z| goes in the groups line and is n. Interval: bootstrap over all kept problems with the count as the statistic, so |Z| varies across resamples. An interval from a bootstrap over Z alone, with |Z| fixed, would be narrower. alt_measured = count/|Z| (a rate rather than a count). refuted_by: count > 9. The prediction's 'about 5' baseline for a fresh base sample is not computed: by construction every B sample is 0 on Z, so a fresh base sample is not measurable from these vectors.
